items.headline: Bitcoin turned back at the $87k wall for the third time since late September
items.blurb: Sellers rejected another move above $87k and BTC slipped back to the mid-$85ks; analysts note price is squeezing into the apex of a triangle.
items.why_matters: A daily close above the ~$87.4–87.7k highs is still the bull trigger; a tightening range with leverage rebuilding raises the odds of a sharp move either way.

items.headline: Spot ETF buying cools sharply as funds hover near holders' breakeven
items.blurb: Bitfinex analysts say weekly spot BTC ETF inflows fell about 90% in the week to Oct 2, and expect an $84k–$87.7k range while spot demand stays soft.
items.why_matters: Flows are still net positive but too thin to break the range; ETF holders' average cost near $84k is the support line to watch.

items.headline: CFTC proposes crypto rules days after an SEC custody proposal
items.blurb: Bitcoin twice popped above $86k on the CFTC news before fading back into its range.
items.why_matters: Regulatory clarity is a slow-burn tailwind for institutional access, but it hasn't been enough on its own to break resistance.

items.headline: Fed minutes due today, September CPI next week
items.blurb: Minutes of the September hike meeting land on Oct 7; CPI follows on Oct 14, ahead of the Oct 27–28 FOMC.
items.why_matters: With the 10-year yield near multi-decade highs, any hawkish signal on further hikes is the main macro risk to crypto's range.

items.headline: Weekly Fed liquidity read still the Wed 09-30 print until Thursday
items.blurb: The latest weekly Fed balance-sheet observation showed net liquidity falling; the next release is Thu Oct 8.
items.why_matters: If Thursday's release confirms a turn, the main structural headwind fades; a second contracting week keeps the 1-month outlook cautious.
